tooltip.bscoins.bs_coin: RC: tip/stun/8-zone | Hold RC: circle | Q or V: throw | Sneak+Q: one-click test setup (floor + dummy, 1 coin)
tooltip.bscoins.bs_coin_2: Slows down in flight: the faster it hits, the harder | Sticks where it lands like an arrow, walk close to pick it up | Burns past 130 blocks of range
tooltip.bscoins.dev_bs_coin: Dev coin - special: unlimited range, never burns | Sneak+Q reloads datapacks (edit data/ JSON and see it live)
tooltip.bscoins.like: Right click: like yourself and nearby players (Goad buff)
tooltip.bscoins.coin_toss: Right click: flip a coin, heads = Luck / tails = Bad Luck
tooltip.bscoins.favorite: Right click a block: bookmark it | Sneak+right click: list bookmarks
tooltip.bscoins.nag_megaphone: Right click: shout a fan-shaped area toward where you look (default +-45 deg, 32 blocks); everyone inside gets a nag message and the Goad buff
tooltip.bscoins.nag_megaphone_2: Horn sound + fan-shaped sound-wave particles so the covered area is obvious; cooldown prevents spam
tooltip.bscoins.pigeon_trap: Right click: release 5 live pigeons (parrots) that scatter with a puff of smoke
tooltip.bscoins.pigeon_trap_2: Released pigeons fly off and despawn naturally like any mob
tooltip.bscoins.pressure_letter: Nag letter: go use your coins!
tooltip.bscoins.pressure_letter_2: Skip using coins for days and it keeps following you
message.bscoins.tip: Beishan Coin! You got Goad + Boss buffs!
message.bscoins.villager: Shop VIP: villager gives you permanent 20%% off!
message.bscoins.megaphone: Nag megaphone: %s player(s) nagging with you - Goad applied!
message.bscoins.megaphone_shout: %s is nagging you to update with a megaphone! (Goad %ss)
message.bscoins.pigeon_trap: %s pigeons burst out of the trap! Coo coo!
message.bscoins.photo_show: %s flashes a limited-edition Beishan Photo at you!
message.bscoins.airdrop: Airdrop deployed - slowly descending from %s blocks up...
message.bscoins.reload_failed: Reload failed! See the server log for details (no coin was consumed)
message.bscoins.no_coin: You are not holding a Beishan Coin
message.bscoins.pressure_start: Warning! You neglected Beishan Coin - Nag Letter issued!
message.bscoins.favorite_empty: No bookmarks yet - right click a block to add one
message.bscoins.coin_burned: The coin flew past its range and burned up!
advancement.bscoins.root.title: Beishan Coin
advancement.bscoins.sanlian.title: Triple Support
advancement.bscoins.sanlian.description: Craft a Beishan Coin (Like + Toss + Favorite)
bscoins.configuration.title: BS Coins Config
bscoins.configuration.parts.tooltip: Crafting parts and master switches: turning one off removes its recipe and disables the item (needs /reload or a restart).
bscoins.configuration.trio.tooltip: Numbers for the trio parts themselves (Like / Coin Toss / Favorite / Pickaxe).
bscoins.configuration.particles.tooltip: Particles around your feet while holding a Beishan Coin.
bscoins.configuration.interact.tooltip: The three right-click targets: tip players / stun or infight mobs / villager discount.
bscoins.configuration.circle.tooltip: The Team Circle, spawned by holding right-click.
bscoins.configuration.throw.tooltip: Physics and feel of the coin throw (Q / V).
bscoins.configuration.dev.tooltip: Debug helpers: dev assistant GUI / one-click test setup / test dummy.
bscoins.configuration.pressure.tooltip: Nag Letter: the punishment for days without using a Beishan Coin.
bscoins.configuration.shop.tooltip: Beishan shop: replaces the wandering trader and sells items for emeralds.
bscoins.configuration.megaphone.tooltip: Megaphone cone shout and the pigeon trap.
bscoins.configuration.airdrop.tooltip: Structure airdrop: a crate slowly descending from the sky.
bscoins.configuration.enableLike.tooltip: Enables the Like part (redstone + paper) and its buff.
bscoins.configuration.enableToss.tooltip: Enables the Coin Toss part (emerald + iron ingot) and its coin flip.
bscoins.configuration.enableFavorite.too: Enables the Favorite part (book and quill + ender pearl) and its bookmark list.
bscoins.configuration.enableBsCoin.toolt: Enables the Beishan Coin (shapeless craft of all three parts, stacks to 64) and every right-click action.
bscoins.configuration.enableDevCoin.tool: Enables the Dev Beishan Coin (coin + nether star): never burns, unlimited range.
bscoins.configuration.likeBuffSeconds.to: How long the Goad buff from Like lasts, in seconds.
bscoins.configuration.tossLuckSeconds.to: Duration of Luck / Bad Luck from a coin flip, in seconds.
bscoins.configuration.favoriteMax.toolti: How many coordinates the bookmark list can hold.
bscoins.configuration.enablePickaxeAreaM: Infra Pickaxe mines a 3x3 area; sneak to mine a single block.
bscoins.configuration.enableHeldParticle: Three-colour particles around your feet while holding a Beishan Coin; turn off if they block your view.
bscoins.configuration.particleCount.tool: Number of particles in the ring; lower it if they block your view.
bscoins.configuration.enableTip.tooltip: Right-click a player to tip them (Goad + Boss buffs).
bscoins.configuration.tipDurationSeconds: Duration of the tip buffs, in seconds.
bscoins.configuration.enableMonsterAttac: Right-click a mob to stun it or make nearby mobs infight.
bscoins.configuration.stunChance.tooltip: Chance to stun (0~1); every other roll triggers infighting.
bscoins.configuration.infightRadius.tool: Radius in blocks used to look for infighting targets.
bscoins.configuration.enableVillagerDisc: Right-click a villager for a permanent 20%% discount.
bscoins.configuration.enableTeamCircle.t: Hold right-click for 3 seconds to spawn a Team Circle.
bscoins.configuration.circleDurationSeco: How long the circle lasts, in seconds (600 = 10 minutes).
bscoins.configuration.circleCropBoost.to: The team circle speeds up crops.
bscoins.configuration.circleXpBoost.tool: The team circle spawns extra experience.
bscoins.configuration.circleConsume.tool: Beishan Coins consumed to spawn a circle.
bscoins.configuration.enableThrow.toolti: Throwing the coin with Q / V.
bscoins.configuration.throwSpeed.tooltip: Initial speed in blocks/tick (vanilla snowball 1.5, arrow 3.0; 10.0 ~= 82 blocks of flat range).
bscoins.configuration.throwDrag.tooltip: Speed multiplier per tick; lower means it slows down faster (1.0 = no drag).
bscoins.configuration.throwGravity.toolt: Gravity in blocks/tick^2 (snowball 0.03, arrow 0.05). Higher = shorter range, but falling adds speed back.
bscoins.configuration.throwDamage.toolti: Damage on hit at full initial speed; the real damage scales with the speed at the moment of impact. Players only get buffs, never damage.
bscoins.configuration.throwDamageMax.too: Upper damage limit after the speed bonus.
A normal Beishan Coin burns up past this horizontal range in blocks; the dev coin is immune.
Walk within this many blocks to pick a stuck coin back up.
bscoins.configuration.throwPickupOwnerOn: Only the thrower may pick the coin back up (off = anyone walking by can).
bscoins.configuration.throwMaxLifetimeSe: Fallback lifetime in seconds: a normal coin burns up, the dev coin drops as an item.
bscoins.configuration.throwCooldownTicks: Cooldown in ticks (20 = 1 second), drawn as the vanilla white sweep on the hotbar item; 0 = no cooldown.
bscoins.configuration.throwTrail.tooltip: A spark trail along the flight (the dev coin uses white end-rod glints) plus a marker particle every 2 seconds on a stuck coin so it is easy to find again.
bscoins.configuration.enableDevAssistant: Sneak + right-click air / press G to open the Beishan Dev Assistant GUI (costs 1 coin).
bscoins.configuration.enableTestPlatform: Sneak + Q lays a platformSize x platformSize platform under your feet (shares 1 coin with the dummy).
bscoins.configuration.enableTestDummy.to: Sneak + Q also spawns a test dummy in front of you (health bar / damage numbers).
bscoins.configuration.dummyLifetimeSecon: How many seconds the dummy lives before it disappears.
bscoins.configuration.enableReload.toolt: Sneak + Q with the dev coin reloads datapacks (loot tables, recipes, tags). Costs one coin, and no operator permission is needed.
bscoins.configuration.assistantConsume.t: Beishan Coins consumed to open the dev assistant.
bscoins.configuration.enablePressure.too: Nag letter punishment: 5 in-game days without crafting or using a Beishan Coin.
bscoins.configuration.pressureDays.toolt: Consecutive unused in-game days before the nag triggers.
bscoins.configuration.pressureSlowPercen: Slowness applied by the nag, in percent.
bscoins.configuration.pressurePigeonTick: Interval in ticks between pigeon particles above your head.
bscoins.configuration.enableShop.tooltip: Replace the wandering trader with the Beishan shop.
bscoins.configuration.megaphoneRadius.to: Shout radius in blocks; players inside the cone within this radius get the nag message and Goad.
bscoins.configuration.megaphoneAngleDegr: Cone opening in degrees, split left and right; 90 = +-45 degrees straight ahead.
bscoins.configuration.megaphoneBuffSecon: Goad duration applied by the megaphone, in seconds.
bscoins.configuration.megaphoneCooldownS: Megaphone cooldown in seconds, to prevent spam.
bscoins.configuration.pigeonTrapCount.to: How many pigeons (parrots) one trap releases.
Height in blocks the airdrop crate starts falling from.
bscoins.configuration.airdropFallSpeed.t: Crate descent speed in blocks/tick; 0.15 ~= 3 blocks per second.
